item.title: LOT-052: MPStorage transport (find, read, create, merge-and-save)
item.body:
LOT-052
Closes #78
Claim: cloud/lot-052

**Problem.** The MPStorage document (synced blocklist, bookmarks, MP flags) had parsing (LOT-038) and merge (LOT-062) but no flow that finds the thread, reads it, creates it or writes it.

**Cause / legacy.** `Classes/MPStorage.m` @ 2440d79: reads the *rendered* page, posts a hand-made field list with the main account's cookies and stored token, overwrites the whole document (last writer wins), and judges success by "succès" anywhere (the async save checks a thread page, so it is always "failed", `:932-967`).

**Change** (`Sources/HFRClient/MPStorage/`, spec `docs/lots/LOT-052-mpstorage-transport.md`):
- `findThread`: MP list page 1, then `nextPath` (LOT-038 per page); off-forum pages/links or a non-advancing pager → `unexpectedPage`; 50 pages → `searchLimitReached` (never "not found", so no duplicate thread).
- `read(post:)`: thread first page (`R60a`, no redirect) locates the first message; its toolbar edit link (checked: `/message.php`, `cat=prive`, this `post`/`numreponse`) → edit form (`R60b`) through LOT-048, checked (edit shape, private, `post`, `numreponse`, `sujet` = subject); the document is `content_form` (stored bytes, HFR-PROTOCOL §7 X8). `RA5` → `notAddressed`.
- `save(ours, base:, at:, stamp:)`: re-read the form (theirs), LOT-062 merge, no write when `needsWrite` is false, write guards, LOT-048 `edit`, read back: stored text must equal the text sent, else `notVerified(stored:)`.
- `create(stamp:)`: find first (`.existing`, no POST), else new-MP form (`R45b`, `dest=MultiMP`) + LOT-048 `newPrivateMessage` with legacy's empty template, then find + read (`.created`).
- HFRNetwork: `HFREndpoint.privateThreadFirstPage(post:)`, `newPrivateMessageForm(to:)`.
No caching, alerts or on/off state: those stay in the app (LOT-130). Docs: HFR-PROTOCOL §6c `### LOT-052`, CHANGELOG-LEGACY #56.

**Tests** (30 new client tests + 2 endpoint tests; full suite 1306 green locally): `MPStorageTransportReadTests`, `MPStorageTransportWriteTests`, `MPStorageListWalkTests`, `HFREndpointReadTests`, on captures `R13a`, `R13u1`, `R60a`, `R60b`, `RA5`, `RA1`, `R43a`, `R45b`, `W10`, `W15`, `W17a`. Shown to fail without: read-back comparison, subject check, find-before-create, pager progress check. Multi-page MP walk tested with pager values (no multi-page capture yet, #333).

**Pending capture** (not hand-built): storage on page ≥ 2 (#333), non-empty/foreign documents (#272), a storage write/creation answer (uses MP `W15`/`W10`).

Related: #362 (LOT-073) changes `MPStorageCodec` internals only; this PR uses `decode`/`encodeForWriting` and does not depend on it.

Security review details
**Security Blast Radius** - _observed_ — Operations exercise the supplied forum account's authenticated session. Sessions have independent cookie jars and no shared cache or credential store; posting additionally restricts destinations to the HTTPS forum origin. No broader production-dependent exposure was established. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Thread reads require a forum edit link with matching private category, thread and first-message identifiers. Loaded forms must match edit shape, private-thread status, identifiers and storage subject. Posting uses the session retained by the fetched form and suppresses deletion during edits. - _observed_ — Account binding remains outside the location type and save API. The documented cross-account thread capture is denied as not addressed, which counters an ordinary cross-account read path. It does not establish the server's edit-POST authorization behavior for an independently supplied location; that capture remains pending. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — Pre-send cancellation is distinguished from uncertain post-send outcomes. Posting sends once without automatic retry; save reports failed or mismatched read-back as not verified. Creation can leave a completed thread after a subsequent lookup failure, with rediscovery as the documented recovery path rather than rollback. **Hardening Proposals** - _proposed_ — Before application adoption, bind cached locations and base snapshots to account identity, coordinate local sync and creation per account, and validate the pending cross-account edit and storage-write outcomes. Local coordination should not be presented as solving cross-device atomicity.

review_comments.body:
** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Correct the "nothing was written" contract in the doc comment.** The comment says every case except `posting(.unconfirmed)` and `notVerified` means nothing was written. This is wrong for `MPStorageTransport.create`. After HFR confirms the POST in `create`, the later `findThread` and `read` calls can throw `notFoundAfterCreation`, `network`, `list`, `unexpectedPage`, `searchLimitReached`, `threadPage` and `posting`. In these cases the thread exists. A caller that trusts the comment may treat these errors as "no thread was created" and report the wrong state to the user. A retry is safe, because `create` searches first. The contract is still wrong. Name the creation cases in the comment, or list which operations can throw these cases after a confirmed write.
